desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on rising Iran-related maritime incidents and diplomacy in the Middle East, alongside Japan’s new defence white paper. The single most important thread is multiple reports of attacks and explosions tied to Iranian waters and territory.

## MAIN THREADS
### Japan’s 2026 Defence White Paper
- @Osinttechnical posted the cover and key excerpts, noting Japan’s focus on population-driven manpower shortages and a drone-heavy force structure drawing lessons from Ukraine.[[1]](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2114737407702581365)
- The same account added that Japan assesses North Korea is building military forces in partnership with Russia.[[2]](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2114737417941090424)

### Iranian President’s Moscow Trip
- @hey_itsmyturn reported President Masoud Pezeshkian is en route to Moscow to meet Vladimir Putin and the Qatari Emir.[[3]](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2114749756786495777)

### Maritime Incidents Near Iran/Iraq
- @sentdefender reported a vessel on fire after an attack near Basra port, Iraq, noting it follows more than two dozen Iranian attacks on shipping since early October.[[4]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114717773779648768)
- @hey_itsmyturn reported a blast heard in the Strait of Hormuz near the Iranian coast, launched from Sirik.[[5]](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2114720640309825923)

### Explosions Inside Iran
- @hey_itsmyturn reported blasts in Parchin (east of Tehran) attributed to UXO.[[6]](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2114697544357863561)
- @sentdefender noted talks beginning in Tehran between Mecca Joint Defense Agreement nations and Iran.[[7]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114721583692411243)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- @hey_itsmyturn: Blast in Strait of Hormuz near Iranian coast (unconfirmed). [post link](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2114718981428764676)
- @hey_itsmyturn: Blasts in Parchin due to UXO (unconfirmed). [post link](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2114697544357863561)
- @sentdefender: Vessel attacked near Basra port is part of >24 Iranian shipping attacks since early October (unconfirmed). [post link](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114717773779648768)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for further Iranian maritime activity or escalation around the Strait of Hormuz and Basra. Japan’s white paper signals longer-term drone and manpower policy shifts.
